nos_units.nos_title: Access control of premises for people and vehicles
kus: KU1. Understand and implement access control procedures per organizational guidelines.
KU2. Identify and verify the identity and authorization of incoming/outgoing individuals, vehicles,
KU3. Stop unauthorized access and promptly report incidents to relevant supervisors or departments.
KU4. Notify concerned departments/supervisors upon arrival of relevant consignments.
KU5. Verify vehicle authorization and report any irregularities observed during passage.
KU6. Alert supervisors regarding any observed irregularities during vehicle transit.
KU7. Support seniors in maintaining duty post registers.
KU8. Use basic security equipment like metal detectors and torches effectively.
KU9. Ensure proper housekeeping and safety measures at the duty location.
KU10. Perform security equipment maintenance as instructed by the organization.
gs: GS1. Grasp the importance of access control procedures within organizational protocols.
